cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the national system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register, or gives its reporting completeness.
cells.note: A research team working with the health ministry used monthly facility data, January 2019 to February 2024, from the Kenya Health Information System on DHIS2 (KEN-011), so a national system is in service: 3. The move of facilities from the SHA portal to HMIS platforms is a separate rollout; no link to surveillance, supply or a register is shown, so not 4.
